test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

I said to Hia, “Don’t litter”.

options.text: I advised Hia to not litter.
I implored Hia not to litter.
I ordered Hia to not litter.
I offered Hia to not litter.

solution:
The correct answer is **"I implored Hia not to litter."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in direct speech as the speaker is reporting what they said to someone else.
 
• In indirect speech, the reporting verb (said) is followed by a conjunction (that) and the sentence is changed to the third person.
 
• The verb **'don't litter'** is changed to **'not to litter' **in indirect speech.
 
• The sentence becomes "I implored Hia not to litter."

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Option 1, "I advised Hia to not litter"** is incorrect as the original sentence expresses a command, not advice.
 
• **Option 3, "I ordered Hia to not litter"** is incorrect as the original sentence is not as forceful as an order.
 
• **Option 4, "I offered Hia to not litter"** is incorrect as the original sentence does not involve an offer.
